description: Read a photo and extract location fields from it (Gemini Vision, costs quota). Returns the fields — it does NOT create a board; feed the result into lab_create_location yourself. Note the payload: the image travels as base64 inside the call, so keep it small (a downscaled JPEG, not a full-resolution capture).

image_base64.description: The image as base64. A data-URL prefix ('data:image/jpeg;base64,…') is stripped by the backend

name: lab_analyze_location_image
title: Analyze Location Image
